Initializes compute budget details with default limits, sizes, and counters.

# Purpose
This file defines [`fd_compute_budget_details_new`](<#fd_compute_budget_details_new>), a constructor-style function that initializes an `fd_compute_budget_details_t` structure with default values. It clears all update flags, sets the compute unit limit and compute meter to `200000UL`, sets the compute unit price to `0`, and assigns the default heap size and loaded accounts data size limit from `fd_vm.h`. It also resets the instruction counters and the requested heap size instruction index to zero.
